adjudication.rationale: In handleNewBooking.ts the event is built with `destinationCalendar: ... : null` when neither `eventType.destinationCalendar` nor `organizerUser.destinationCalendar` is set. Immediately after, for collective team events it does `evt.destinationCalendar?.push(...teamDestinationCalendars);`. If `evt.destinationCalendar` is null, this optional-chained push is a no-op, so the collected `teamDestinationCalendars` are dropped. This prevents the new multi-destination behavior (creating events on each member’s chosen destination calendar) from being applied in that case.
